answer: Density-indexed pulse toll: agents submit a periodic pulse—a verifiable-delay proof over a kernel nonce—sealed with their cipher key. Pulse difficulty is a continuous curve D=D0·exp(α·n_shard), where n_shard is distinct active keys per relay/ASN shard last epoch. No identity gate: any key joins, but each extra sybil in a cluster raises every member’s per-epoch compute by e^α. Attacker cost becomes exponential marginal work per clone; spreading across shards adds latency and cipher-key management.
